# Release request

Publish the current main branch through the existing Windows workflow.

Application changes prepared in commit 420891c1ee43a7dffe6b98a7431a3ade3af3ad62:
- Explicit controller navigation for home, library and details.
- Hide cursor on gamepad input and restore it on mouse movement.
- Graphical footer prompts using SDL button labels.
- Card selection background instead of an outline.
- Open review discussions in the embedded Steam view.

Windows build and packaging must succeed before publication. Runtime behavior on the user's controller has not been verified. Steam authentication, a native store and the complete agreed redesign are not implemented by this release.
